name: audio_benchmarks
description: A collection of audio tasks and files intended to evaluate models on common audio problems such as speech recognition, audio classification, and speaker/accents identification. The benchmark measures model performance across different audio task types and datasets, assessing robustness to varying acoustic conditions and labeling schemes. It is useful for gauging general audio/speech capability and cross-task performance.
reputation: A small, general-purpose audio collection with limited visibility compared to established audio benchmarks (e.g., LibriSpeech, VoxCeleb).
